name: Aromatic fragrances

card.summary: A herbal, lavender-led fragrance subfamily that gives a clean, fresh scent profile people wear as part of grooming.
card.note: Fragranced products can cause skin irritation or allergy in some people.

quick.overview:
Aromatic fragrances are a perfumery subfamily built on lavender and aromatic herbs. They read as fresh and clean, and wearers choose them as a classic, grooming-oriented scent.

In Michael Edwards' Fragrance Wheel, Aromatic sits within the Fresh family between Dry Woods and Citrus, with lavender as the example note.
quick.how: People wear them as colognes or eau de toilette as part of a grooming routine, often matched to occasions or seasons.
quick.risks: Fragrance ingredients may irritate or sensitize skin in some people; spot testing is common practice.

lead: Aromatic fragrances are a subfamily of the Fresh group in Michael Edwards' Fragrance Wheel, characterized by lavender and aromatic herbs. [1] They contribute to looks indirectly: smelling clean and pleasant is part of grooming and overall presentation.

The Fragrance Wheel descends from Paul Jellinek's 1949 odor diagram and U. Harder's 1979 circle; Edwards published his version in 1992 and revised it in 2008 and 2010. Before 2010, Fougere sat at the center of the wheel; the 2010 version places Aromatic between Dry Woods and Citrus. [1]

chain: Wear a lavender or herbal fragrance
angle.text: Scent is part of how a person is perceived alongside appearance. Aromatic scents are chosen for a fresh, classic, barbershop-style impression.

paras: Aromatic is one of the subfamilies of the Fresh family in Edwards' 2010 wheel, with lavender as its example. [1]
No studies found on aromatic fragrances as a style category.

timeline.event: Revision places Aromatic in the Fresh family. [1]
